uncertain.note: the glyph after 'me' is the italic marker ſ (slanted, with a descender, unlike the roman ſ of 'meſme' beside it) and the period follows it; there is no round s between 'me' and the marker. p003 ends 'à la fem-', so the word completed is 'femme'.

uncertain.text: les anciẽs Romains demõſtroyent biẽ aux enfans des Se
uncertain.note: 'anciẽs' and 'biẽ' carry a mark over the e read as a tilde (same shape as over the o in 'demõſtroyent'); it could be read as an acute. 'biẽ aux' is set very tight.

uncertain.text: que l'hõme & la femme peuuent produire ſemence for-
uncertain.note: a faint speck sits after 'produire' at the baseline; at 4x it is far smaller than the periods of 'dixſeptieme.' and 'neufieme.' on this page, so it is taken as an ink speck, not a period

uncertain.text: bãdée tout à l'ẽtour de pourpre, qu'ils appeloyẽt PRAE
uncertain.note: 'P R AE' is set in spaced capitals (P and R spaced, A and E tight but two sorts, not an Æ ligature); closed up per §3, spaced_caps set on the block; the word continues as 'T E X T A.' on the next line, likewise closed up. 'B V L L A' on line 17 is the same.
the Digest abbreviation is a swash italic capital D; transcribed as plain 'D'
the first one or two letters are lost under an ink blot; 'res.' (continuing 'pube-' from the line above) is the best reading, only '…rs.' is actually legible
a free-standing italic 'x' is printed after 'maux' before 'c. v.'; legible at 4x, makes no obvious sense in the citation; transcribed as printed

first character is a plain upright italic stroke with serifs, read as 'I'; very likely 'l' (lex) in intent, since the italic l elsewhere has a looped ascender. The mark after it reads as a comma but could be a period.
a very faint mark follows 'leg' (a period or a line-end hyphen), not transcribed; a small dash is also printed immediately before the key letter y of the next note, apparently stray type
no period after 'vij': at 4x the only mark between the j and the l is a speck about a third the size of the periods in 'ſtoire. c. iij.' two lines below, sitting against the foot of the l
the final numeral shows three minims (i-i-j) at 4x, so 'iij'; at reading size it can look like 'ij'
